note: Written by scenes/_AscensionAudit.tscn -- --json=... for tools/art/evolution_icons.py. Do not edit by hand.

cards.name: Reflective Plating
cards.description: What the shield absorbs flies back at the nearest enemy as a shaft of light, at 150%. +15 shield.

cards.name: Rampart
cards.description: Blocks enemy shots. Each blocked shot costs 50% of its damage in shield points. Shield recharges 20% sooner.

cards.name: Reforged
cards.description: As the ward is rebuilt, iron shards fly in and cut the enemies they pass. +20% shield.

cards.name: Sun Aegis
cards.description: A breaking shield flashes like the sun, staggering and weakening everything close. Double shield.

cards.name: Thorn Crystal Shell
cards.description: A breaking shield bursts into crystal shards that cut everything close for twice its size. +40 shield.

cards.name: Harmony
cards.description: Takes the element of the spell in the next slot: ice slows, lightning staggers, poison poisons, others hit harder. +20% damage.

cards.name: Storm Chord
cards.description: The chord crackles with static: +20% damage, and hits stagger for 0.3 s.

cards.name: Sustain
cards.description: Each burst's note rings on in the ground for 2.5s and hurts what stands in it (+40% Area).

cards.name: Resonance
cards.description: Every burst goes off again wherever each of your other spells last struck. +180% damage.

cards.name: Fermata
cards.description: A held note: time stops for 2.5s where it sounds - all it catches, and whatever walks in, freezes. +190% damage, 80% wider.

cards.name: Crushing Grip
cards.description: Every slap coils round its target's legs and roots it for 2 seconds. +50% slap damage.

cards.name: Fling
cards.description: A slap hurls its target across the pit at the farthest enemy, hitting all round where it lands. +1 tentacle, 20% wider.

cards.name: Soul Drain
cards.description: Every 4th slap tears out a wisp of life that heals you 1 HP, up to 3 HP a cast.

cards.name: Elder God Maw
cards.description: A vast maw ringed with eyes opens instead (+50% size), dragging all inside to its teeth. Slaps +200% damage.

cards.name: Shadow Forest
cards.description: The rift breaks into seven small pits over a field half again as wide. Opens 44% sooner, slaps +120% damage.

cards.name: Burrs
cards.description: Whatever leaves the thicket carries burrs for 2.5s that slow and prick it. +25% damage, 15% wider.

cards.name: Runners
cards.description: Half grown, the thicket sends 3 thorned runners to the nearest enemies, cutting and slowing. Grows 25% faster.

cards.name: Ironbriar
cards.description: The thorns grow iron: +20% damage, and the first hit Withers 5% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Bramble Keep
cards.description: One great thicket three times as wide, hedged with thorns that slow to a crawl. It stands while you stay in it. +80% damage.

cards.name: Thornstorm
cards.description: Grown thickets throw rings of 24 thorns every 0.8s. 2 more may stand, -30% cooldown, +70% damage.

cards.name: Storm Surge
cards.description: The arc splits three ways at every hop for 30% less, up to 20 arcs a cast, and hits slow by 25% for 1.5 s.

cards.name: Storm Reach
cards.description: Each hop leaps to the farthest enemy in reach, sprawling across the pack. 3 more hops, 35% longer, 15% weaker each.

cards.name: Return Stroke
cards.description: Where the chain ends, the stroke runs back along it to your hand, striking every enemy on the way again for 80%. +30% damage.

cards.name: Cascade
cards.description: Every enemy a hop kills throws 2 more arcs, up to 37 arcs a cast. +50% damage.

cards.name: Electrocution
cards.description: The first enemy struck is held for 1.2s, shocked again and again; if it dies, the next is held. +50% damage, +1 hop.

cards.name: Backdraft
cards.description: A second flame, turned on an enemy of its own and never the way the first faces. Each flame deals 60% damage.

cards.name: Ember Wake
cards.description: The jet leaves embers: the cone it swept burns for 2s. Tongues thrown 25% faster.

cards.name: Hellbreath
cards.description: The fire burns black: +20% damage, and hits leave enemies Vulnerable (+10% damage taken) for 2 s.

cards.name: Dragon's Breath
cards.description: A dragon's breath, 75% longer and twice as wide, raising a wall of fire where each burn ends. +80% damage.

cards.name: Fire Fan
cards.description: One broad flame sweeps back and forth across a wide arc in front of you. Flames 50% wider, 50% faster recharge, +140% damage.

cards.name: Deep Freeze
cards.description: Enemies hit by the cone are frozen solid for 1.2 seconds.

cards.name: Arctic Blast
cards.description: The cone opens into a half-moon: the ice sprays 180 degrees across the front of you instead of 60, and reaches 40% farther.

cards.name: Frost Shrapnel
cards.description: Meltwater runs through the cone: +30% damage.

cards.name: Zero Point Shockwave
cards.description: The cold bursts on from the cone's tip as a second cone, 50% as long. Reaches 40% farther, +120% damage.

cards.name: Glacier Tide
cards.description: The blast goes out as a wall of ice that throws everything it hits away from you. +100% damage.

cards.name: Fever Burst
cards.description: A dead carrier bursts into a fever cloud that hits for 60% and lingers 1.5s, infecting. +25% damage.

cards.name: Outbreak
cards.description: The first carrier bursts the moment it is infected, spreading the plague at once, and still jumps when it dies.

cards.name: Marsh Fever
cards.description: The plague travels by water: +20% damage, and hits slow by 25% for 3 s.

cards.name: Pandemic
cards.description: Every 2s every carrier bursts at once without dying, infecting what is near. Jumps 50% farther, +80% damage.

cards.name: Plague Wind
cards.description: Each cast also looses a plague cloud that infects all it drifts through. Plagues reach 8 more, -40% cooldown, +60% damage.

cards.name: Twin Fires
cards.description: On its first bounce a ball splits into twin fires that fly off their own ways, each striking for 70% of the ball.

cards.name: Static Wake
cards.description: Each ball leaves a wake of static that crackles for a moment, zapping whatever stands in it for 30% of a strike.

cards.name: Spindrift
cards.description: The fire burns sea-blue and its spray drenches what it strikes: +20% damage, and hits slow by 30% for 1.5 s.

cards.name: Storm Lantern
cards.description: The edges throw each ball home: it hangs over you like a masthead light, then flies out a new way. +30% damage.

cards.name: Saint's Crown
cards.description: When you are crowded, the balls circle close round you in a crown until the crowd thins. +1 ball every cast, +20% damage.

cards.name: Twin Gyres
cards.description: A second ring of 3 blades spins the other way, close in, catching what slips past. +1 outer blade, 30% faster.

cards.name: Razor Gale
cards.description: The blades are edged in steel: +35% damage, and the first hit Withers 4% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Wind Shear
cards.description: At a full gust the blades fling crescents of wind every 0.6s that fly on past the ring. Spins 25% faster.

cards.name: Typhoon Core
cards.description: A permanent hurricane: the ring never falls in when you stop, and is two and a half times the size. +100% damage.

cards.name: Vortex Reaper
cards.description: The whirlwind drags the crowd round it in to the blades, and they cut harder. +150% damage.

cards.name: Grimalkin
cards.description: Its cast speed and evasion x1.4, and its Weaken lasts 5.6 s.

cards.name: Cait Sith
cards.description: What it pounces on takes 25% more from every spell for 3 s.

cards.name: Purr
cards.description: Every 20 s it runs to you and heals 3 HP.

cards.name: Nine Lives
cards.description: +1 life: when you would fall, you stand back up with half your health.

cards.name: Cath Palug
cards.description: Its cast speed and evasion x1.5 again, and its pounce marks everything in a reach 2.5x as wide.

cards.name: Black Cat
cards.description: Every 3 s it casts one of your attack spells at random, from where it stands.

cards.name: Great Raven
cards.description: Pecks deal +30% damage. Its beak is 80% wider, hitting enemies beside its target.

cards.name: Stormcrow
cards.description: The crow flies out of the storm: +20% damage, and hits stagger for 0.2 s.

cards.name: Murder of Crows
cards.description: Adds 1 crow with its own target. All crows deal 10% less peck damage.

cards.name: The Morrigan
cards.description: Peck damage +100%. Below 30% health, ordinary enemies die instantly; elites and bosses take 2x damage.

cards.name: Griffin
cards.description: Swoops through every enemy along its path. Damage +20%; time between attacks +30%.

cards.name: Great Hound
cards.description: Bites deal +20% damage. Jaws are 40% wider, catching enemies beside its target.

cards.name: Rimehound
cards.description: Bite damage +20%. Slows enemies by 30% for 1.5 s. Jaw width +40%.

cards.name: Littermates
cards.description: Adds 2 pups: 3 hounds total. Each hunts its own target. All hounds deal 55% less bite damage.

cards.name: Cerberus
cards.description: Each bite hits up to 3 enemies near its target. Bite damage +10%.

cards.name: Hound of Annwn
cards.description: Hunts elites and bosses first, dealing 2x damage to them. Bite damage +120%, jaw width +50%.

cards.name: Pyroclasm
cards.description: Impact leaves a pool of burning magma that scorches ground for 3 seconds.

cards.name: Cluster Bombs
cards.description: Each blast throws out 3 bomblets that burst just past its edge for half damage.

cards.name: Iron Comet
cards.description: The fireball is forged around an iron core: the first hit Withers 5% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Brimstone
cards.description: Each blast leaves a lump of burning brimstone that spits small fireballs at the nearest enemies for 3s. +10% damage.

cards.name: Armageddon Sun
cards.description: A slow, swollen sun ploughs through the pack, searing all it touches, and bursts beyond it. +30% damage, 60% wider blast.

cards.name: Torn Leaf
cards.description: A page tears in two on its first strike, and each half flies on at another enemy nearby for half its cut.

cards.name: Inkblot
cards.description: Where a page strikes, its ink spills: a black stain that slows whatever walks through it by 35%. +15% damage.

cards.name: Gilt Edge
cards.description: Every page is edged in gold and cuts on through 2 more enemies, flying 25% faster.

cards.name: Bound Volume
cards.description: Each turn of the book flies bound as one volume to the thickest pack and bursts open there. +2 pages a turn, +30% damage.

cards.name: Commonplace Book
cards.description: Whatever a page kills is written into the book: its ink flies back to you and turns another page. +35% damage.

cards.name: Ice Statues
cards.description: The dead stand a moment as statues of ice, then shatter a second time for 60%.

cards.name: Ice Flurry
cards.description: Every shatter flings 2 shards of ice out at the enemies just beyond it; each flies to its enemy and strikes and chills it.

cards.name: Frost Nova Burst
cards.description: The shatter freezes what it catches solid for 1.0s instead of slowing it.

cards.name: Avalanche
cards.description: Enemies killed by a shatter shatter too, up to 3 times in a row, rippling through the pack. +60% damage.

cards.name: Meltwater
cards.description: Corpses melt into pools for 4s, and a shatter that reaches one bursts it into ice spikes. +100% damage.

cards.name: Eddy
cards.description: At the end of its throw the blade spins in place for 0.6s, cutting all round it. +25% damage.

cards.name: Hooked Throw
cards.description: The blade comes home on a wide hook, cutting a second path through the pack. +10% critical strike chance.

cards.name: Live Wire
cards.description: A wire of lightning joins you to the flying blade, cutting what it crosses every 0.2s. The blade flies 20% faster.

cards.name: Thunderhead
cards.description: Each time the blade turns, lightning strikes where it hangs: everything near takes 280% of a cut and is staggered. Every cut +15%.

cards.name: Squall
cards.description: At the end of its throw the blade bursts into 5, each coming home its own way for 75%. -20% cooldown.

cards.name: Shatter
cards.description: Each spike bursts into 6 ice splinters as it withdraws, each for 50% of the spike. +20% damage.

cards.name: Spike Run
cards.description: The spikes race in a line across the front of the pack, the middle one under the target, and 2 more join the run.

cards.name: Rimefoot
cards.description: Every spike leaves the ground it rose from frozen for 3 s: whatever crosses the ice is slowed 45%. +20% damage.

cards.name: Glacier Crown
cards.description: 12 more spikes rise in a ring round the target for 1.5s, penning the pack. Every spike +150% damage.

cards.name: Frozen Spire
cards.description: The spike under the target stands 5s as a pillar that freezes what touches it. -40% cooldown, +80% damage.

cards.name: Night's Cloth
cards.description: While the veil is torn, shots that would find you die in the gloom at your shoulder.

cards.name: Tailwind
cards.description: The tear's gust throws much harder, and the walk re-weaves the veil about 25% sooner.

cards.name: Razor Hem
cards.description: The tear's lash cuts 60% deeper.

cards.name: Second Skin
cards.description: The veil is woven double: it swallows two hits before it is bare. +30% lash.

cards.name: Hour of Gloam
cards.description: The tear dims the world: everything the gust touches is weakened for a while, and the lash cuts twice as deep.

cards.name: Bone Spikes
cards.description: A sprung grave spits 8 shards of bone past the collapse, each for 50% of its damage. +20% damage.

cards.name: Quickset
cards.description: Graves open already armed, right in front of each oncoming enemy. Dug 30% more often.

cards.name: Grave Chill
cards.description: What a grave holds is chilled: it deals 30% less damage while held and 2.5s after. +20% damage.

cards.name: Mass Grave
cards.description: One great grave a cast under the front of the swarm: twice as wide, holding longer and draining what it holds. +80% damage.

cards.name: Grave Line
cards.description: Graves are dug in a line behind you as you walk, or toward the swarm as you stand. 3 more a cast, twice as often, +80% damage.

cards.name: Crush
cards.description: The collapse hits 2% harder for every enemy in the knot, up to 15.

cards.name: Twin Stars
cards.description: Two wells open on two packs and drift together, dragging both into one knot. Each drags 15% harder, +30% damage.

cards.name: Eclipse
cards.description: The well burns with a corona: +20% damage, and hits Weaken enemies (-30% damage dealt) for 3 s.

cards.name: Black Sun
cards.description: The star pulls and collapses 3 times before it fades. Half again as wide, +60% damage.

cards.name: Nova Seed
cards.description: Each collapse throws 3 shards at nearby packs, each opening a smaller well. -40% cooldown, +20% damage.

cards.name: Heavy Draw
cards.description: A full draw looses heavier arrows that throw back and stagger what they hit. +30% damage.

cards.name: Running Shot
cards.description: While you run the bow looses snap shots at the nearest enemy for 60%. The volley still comes when you stop.

cards.name: Barbed
cards.description: An arrow that stops in an enemy stays in it, and the wound bleeds 25% of the arrow's hit every 0.5s for 3s. +10% damage.

cards.name: Rain of Arrows
cards.description: The volley falls as a field of arrows over the nearest pack, 6 for every arrow. +50% damage.

cards.name: Hunter's Mark
cards.description: A full draw marks the strongest enemy: the volley seeks it, and it takes 25% more from all. +3 arrows, +60% damage.

cards.name: Long Stroke
cards.description: The ink lasts 50% longer before it dries away, so the rings you can close grow wider.

cards.name: Wet Ink
cards.description: The line stays wet and stings whatever crosses it for 25% of a ring's strike.

cards.name: Inkwell
cards.description: The ink that floods a closed ring stands there as a pool for a few seconds, slowing whatever wades it by 50%.

cards.name: Ink Prison
cards.description: The closed ring dries into a wall: what it caught cannot get out for a few seconds. +40% damage.

cards.name: Second Stroke
cards.description: A moment after a ring closes the brush goes round it again, and everything inside is struck a second time.

cards.name: Spiked Rail
cards.description: A spiked rail throws back what touches the wall 80% harder and makes it bleed. +20% damage, 15% longer.

cards.name: Caltrops
cards.description: A fallen wall leaves caltrops for 3.5s that cut and slow what walks on them. -25% cooldown.

cards.name: Lightning Rod
cards.description: The stakes draw lightning: +20% damage, and hits stagger for 0.25 s.

cards.name: Iron Ring
cards.description: The stakes close into a ring round the nearest pack, penning it in and cutting whatever leans on them. +150% damage.

cards.name: Rolling Wall
cards.description: The wall marches on, shoving and cutting the pack. Two more walls a cast, each 1s longer, -50% cooldown, +30% damage.

cards.name: Flare
cards.description: The first time a ward meets the pack it flares: a burst of light 1.6 times as wide as its burn, for 2x a strike. +20% damage.

cards.name: Wisp Trail
cards.description: Drifting wards shed wisps of light that hang 2.5s and sear what walks in. Wards drift 25% faster.

cards.name: Rimelight
cards.description: The ward burns cold: +20% damage, and hits slow by 30% for 1.5 s.

cards.name: Pyre
cards.description: Every ward burns as a pyre twice as wide - a small sun drifting into the pack. +80% damage.

cards.name: Kindling Flock
cards.description: The wards circle you as a flock, breaking off to burn what comes near. 3 more, 3s longer, -50% cooldown, +80% damage.

cards.name: Bloodletting
cards.description: A needle that lances a poisoned enemy releases all its remaining poison at once, in one hit.

cards.name: Twin Lancets
cards.description: One more needle every cast, each at the next most wounded enemy.

cards.name: Bodkin
cards.description: The needle is forged a bodkin point: the first hit Withers 5% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Triage
cards.description: A needle that kills flies on to the next most wounded enemy in reach, and on again for every kill.

cards.name: Surgeon's Hand
cards.description: The outright kill takes an ordinary enemy under 20% health, not 10%. +20% damage.

cards.name: Twin Volley
cards.description: The missile forks like lightning on its first hit, two shards flying out either side for 30% damage.

cards.name: Threaded Needle
cards.description: After each hit the missile turns on the nearest enemy it has not struck and flies on, 3 more times.

cards.name: Unstable Detonation
cards.description: Missiles detonate where they hit: an arcane burst throws sparks out round the impact, hitting everything in it for 60% damage.

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.description: Hits leave static; at 3 sparks an enemy bursts in lightning for 3x a missile. Fires 40% faster.

cards.name: Arcane Orb
cards.description: Missiles become a slow orb that rolls through the pack, hitting 5 times a second, then bursts. +50% damage, 50% longer cooldown.

cards.name: Breakup
cards.description: Every meteor breaks apart as it falls and comes down as 3 smaller stones round its mark. +30% damage.

cards.name: Magma Craters
cards.description: Impacts leave burning lava craters that incinerate ground for 4s.

cards.name: Skipstone
cards.description: Every meteor glances off the ground and lands again; the second strike deals 90% of the first's. +35% damage.

cards.name: Extinction Event
cards.description: Every volley ends in one colossal meteor on the thickest pack, 2.5 times as wide and 3 times as hard. +25% damage.

cards.name: Creeping Barrage
cards.description: The volley walks in lines from the nearest enemy through the thickest pack. +8 meteors, -55% cooldown, +60% damage.

cards.name: Sucking Mud
cards.description: The first enemy to wade into each pool is held there for 1 s, the mud heaped round its feet, while the bog bites. +20% damage.

cards.name: Broad Wake
cards.description: Every stride lays its pool with two smaller ones beside it, so the bog spreads three pools across behind you.

cards.name: Fen Gas
cards.description: Each pool breathes out marsh gas that hangs 2.2s and poisons whatever is under it.

cards.name: Great Bog
cards.description: Stand still and the bog spreads into a marsh 3 pools wide that slows all to a crawl. Pools 40% wider, bite 60% harder.

cards.name: Will-o'-Wisps
cards.description: Marsh lights rise from the pools and break on the nearest enemy for 2.5 bites. 5 more pools, +50% damage.

cards.name: Slag Trail
cards.description: The shard's flight leaves a line of burning slag for 2s, and whatever crosses it burns for 30% of a hit every 0.4s. +20% damage.

cards.name: Splitting Shard
cards.description: On its first hit the shard splits; each half homes on a new enemy for 65%. -20% cooldown, 25% faster.

cards.name: Magma Core
cards.description: The shard lodges in what it hits, glowing hotter, and erupts 0.8s later for 130% of the hit on everything round it.

cards.name: Caldera
cards.description: Where the shard strikes, a pool of lava wells up for 4s, burning everything in it. +60% damage.

cards.name: Forge Swarm
cards.description: Shards gather round you and launch 8 at once, each at its own enemy. -50% cooldown, +4 pierce, 40% larger.

cards.name: Splinter Field
cards.description: Splinters of glass punch up under the 4 nearest enemies past the rim, each for 50% of the spike. 15% wider.

cards.name: Umbral Vein
cards.description: Black glass drinks the light: hits leave enemies Vulnerable (+10% damage taken) for 3 s.

cards.name: Deep Strata
cards.description: The spike throws what it breaks under into the air for 0.6s; elites and bosses reel instead. +40% damage, longer reach.

cards.name: Tectonic Uprising
cards.description: Each spike leaves a vent for 3s that throws up fresh spikes under nearby enemies. +80% damage, 30% wider.

cards.name: Basalt Lance
cards.description: A needle of volcanic glass: +140% damage, and 3 more spikes drive on through the crowd behind its target.

cards.name: Burning Rim
cards.description: The ring itself burns: whatever crosses into it takes 60% of a strike and is Weakened. +20% damage.

cards.name: Twin Orbs
cards.description: One more orb runs the star. -20% cooldown.

cards.name: Missile Ward
cards.description: Enemy bolts that enter the ring burn out while the ward stands. +10% damage.

cards.name: Great Circle
cards.description: The circle is drawn half as wide again, and the orb strikes harder. +60% damage.

cards.name: Walking Ward
cards.description: The ward is drawn round you and walks with you; only its time closes it. 2s longer, -20% cooldown, +50% damage.

cards.name: Breaker
cards.description: The wave throws everything it strikes out, away from you. +35% damage, and a wave 30% bigger.

cards.name: Groundswell
cards.description: The wave grows as it runs, from 60% to 180% of its size. -25% cooldown, 25% faster.

cards.name: Undertow
cards.description: The wave's backwash drags everything it strikes back toward you. +20% damage.

cards.name: Brackish Tide
cards.description: The surge runs brackish: +20% damage, and hits poison for 3 dmg/s over 3 s.

cards.name: Tidal Wall
cards.description: The wave swells as it rolls out into a wall 3 times as wide, but comes a third as often.

cards.name: Trident
cards.description: Three waves fan out from your hand at once, each 90% harder.

cards.name: Flashpoint
cards.description: Each ray bursts where it strikes, scorching its neighbours for 50%, wider the hotter it is. +20% damage.

cards.name: Handoff
cards.description: When a ray's target dies, the ray swings to the nearest enemy and keeps the heat it built, once a cast. Rays strike 25% faster.

cards.name: Burn Through
cards.description: The beam runs on through its target to the edge of the screen, burning every enemy on its line. +15% damage.

cards.name: Prism
cards.description: Each ray splits into 4 rays on the enemies round its target, each 80% as strong and as hot. +60% damage.

cards.name: Sunlance
cards.description: Each ray widens into a lance that sweeps on from enemy to enemy, burning all it crosses. -30% cooldown.

cards.name: Great Rune
cards.description: Every fourth rune is great: twice the size, through everything in its line, slowing what it strikes. +25% damage.

cards.name: Braided Wind
cards.description: The runes weave side to side, out of step, braiding a wider stream. +2 runes every cast.

cards.name: Parting Wind
cards.description: What a rune strikes is thrown aside, cutting a lane through the pack. Runes fly 20% faster and farther, +10% damage.

cards.name: Sigil Fan
cards.description: Every cast leaves at once, fanned across 50 degrees: +3 runes, and each passes through 1 more enemy.

cards.name: Turning Gale
cards.description: A rune at the end of its flight is blown back to you, piercing again on the way. +35% damage.

cards.name: Sun Dogs
cards.description: Two mock suns hang beside you and flare with every pulse, each 60% as wide for 80% of its damage. Pulses 25% faster.

cards.name: Solar Prominence
cards.description: Each pulse hurls 2 loops of fire onto the nearest enemies past its rim, more as it builds. +15% damage.

cards.name: Blinding Flash
cards.description: 30% of what the flare catches is staggered and thrown back out of the light.

cards.name: Daybreak Avatar
cards.description: A flare that fills the clearing and burns away every enemy bolt that enters it: +100% area, +100% damage.

cards.name: Corona Discharge
cards.description: Every pulse throws 8 sunbeams far past the flare, each cutting everything along it, and +140% damage.

cards.name: Broadaxe
cards.description: A broader blade: the cleave reaches 25% wider and every blow hits 10% harder.

cards.name: Headsman
cards.description: The axe goes for the wounded: a blow on an enemy under half its health deals double.

cards.name: Dawnsplitter
cards.description: The axe burns with dawn-light: its hits Weaken enemies (-30% damage dealt) for 3 s.

cards.name: Executioner's Greataxe
cards.description: The axe becomes a colossal double-bitted greataxe, twice the size: it cleaves twice as wide and throws what it hits twice as far.

cards.name: Whirling Axes
cards.description: Two more axes, spinning end over end between blows: three heavy blows where there was one.

cards.name: Aftershock
cards.description: The ground answers every slam: 0.4 s later a second shockwave runs out 40% wider for 60% damage, and slows again.

cards.name: Earthshaker
cards.description: A heavier head: every slam reaches 35% wider and slows 15% harder.

cards.name: Hallowed Ground
cards.description: Every slam leaves the ground hallowed for 2.5 s: whatever stands in it is Weakened (-30% damage dealt) and slowed.

cards.name: Mjolnir
cards.description: A giant hammer whose slam stops what it hits and calls lightning onto the 3 nearest enemies past it. Trades Light for Lightning.

cards.name: Hammerfall
cards.description: Two more hammers, falling in turn so the ground never stops shaking. Every slam hits 15% harder.

cards.name: Twin Blades
cards.description: A dagger of light follows each cut from the other side, stabbing the same enemy for 70% of a cut.

cards.name: Deflection
cards.description: Your swords fly out to knock enemy bolts out of the air before they reach you. Each sword can deflect about once a second.

cards.name: Soul Siphon
cards.description: Every strike heals you 1 HP, at most 1 HP a second.

cards.name: Celestial Greatsword
cards.description: The sword becomes a greatsword twice the size. Its stroke cuts every enemy along the blade, and hits 30% harder.

cards.name: Thousand Cuts
cards.description: Every swing becomes a flurry of three cuts, each at 85%. A cut whose quarry has fallen goes to the nearest enemy.

cards.name: Shooting Stars
cards.description: Every third star streaks across the rain from rim to rim, striking all it crosses. +10% damage.

cards.name: Frostfall
cards.description: The stars fall cold: +20% damage, and hits slow by 30% for 1.5 s.

cards.name: Skipping Stars
cards.description: Every star skips on twice like a stone across water, each skip veering up to 80 degrees.

cards.name: Starburst
cards.description: Stars swell and explode 120% wider for +110% damage, throwing 3 sparks. Stars fall half as often.

cards.name: Constellation
cards.description: Stars stay lit for 2.5s, joined by lines of light that strike all they touch. +1 star a burst, each twice as hard.

cards.name: Charged Air
cards.description: The air itself is charged: the storm breaks after one blow fewer.

cards.name: Stormfront
cards.description: The clap rolls 35% farther and throws the pack much harder.

cards.name: Downpour
cards.description: The rain falls harder: its slow deepens by 20% and outlasts the clap.

cards.name: Eye of the Storm
cards.description: The break leaves the storm's eye: for a few seconds enemy shots die at its edge and the rain keeps falling inside. +50% clap.

cards.name: Rolling Thunder
cards.description: The thunder rolls: a second clap follows the first at three quarters of its weight. +50% clap.

cards.name: Ball Lightning
cards.description: The crack at the tip throws off a ball of lightning that rolls on, zapping what it passes. +25% damage.

cards.name: Iron Current
cards.description: The storm runs through iron: +20% damage, and the first hit Withers 5% of an enemy's max HP.

cards.name: Forked Lightning
cards.description: Past its middle the sweep forks into three tongues, sweeping a taller band at its far end. 20% shorter cooldown.

cards.name: Thunderclap
cards.description: Every arc sweeps down and back, each pass ending in a thunderclap for 80% of the sweep.

cards.name: Cardinal Storm
cards.description: Every sweep goes all four ways at once - left, right, up and down - but comes 25% less often.

cards.name: Barbed Lash
cards.description: Thorns break off in what the vine cuts: for 4s, walking tears them open again for 35% of the lash.

cards.name: Snapback
cards.description: After every lash the whip sweeps the same arc back the other way, cutting through as many again.

cards.name: Entangle
cards.description: The vine coils round the feet of everything it cuts and roots it for 0.6 s. +20% damage.

cards.name: Thicket
cards.description: Brambles grow over the arc it swept for 3s, cutting, poisoning and slowing all in them. 30% farther, +60% damage.

cards.name: Hydra Vine
cards.description: One root bursts up in the pack and splits into 3 heads, each lashing its own third of the ring. -40% cooldown.

cards.name: Lingering Rot
cards.description: Each burst leaves a spore cloud as wide as itself for 3.5s that keeps poisoning anything inside. Poison +1 a second.

cards.name: Ember Caps
cards.description: Spores trade Poison for Fire: bursts hit 50% harder and leave 4 burning patches for 2.5s.

cards.name: Giant Caps
cards.description: Two fewer mushrooms, and each takes 67% longer to swell - but bursts 60% wider for +80% damage. Cooldown +20%.

cards.name: Doomcap
cards.description: One titanic Doomcap replaces the scatter: it bursts after 2.6s, 180% wider, stronger for every cap it replaces. Cooldown +40%.

cards.name: Mycelial Bloom
cards.description: Each burst sprouts 2 more mushrooms past its rim that burst at half damage and sprout again. +85% damage.

cards.name: Abyssal Scar
cards.description: The lance leaves a scar of void along its line for 2s, cutting whatever stands on it.

cards.name: Void Glaive
cards.description: The lance runs out of both hands: with every cast a second blade, 75% as long, thrusts out behind you along the same line.

cards.name: Dread
cards.description: Everything the lance pierces flees in dread for 1.6s; elites and bosses stand firm. +20% damage.

cards.name: Witching Hour
cards.description: The lance stays in your hands and sweeps round you like the hand of a clock, once every 2.6s.

cards.name: Cosmic Collapse
cards.description: The lance ends in a black hole that caves in and bursts over everything round it. +140% damage, +120% area.

cards.name: Orchard
cards.description: One more tree may stand at once, so each one stands longer before it is uprooted, and is fuller when you come back.

cards.name: Bramble Fall
cards.description: Every fruit that falls splits into 4 thorns that fly out past where it lands, each striking for 30% of a fruit.

cards.name: Cider Rot
cards.description: The fruit trades Grass for Poison: each one that falls rots where it lands into a patch that poisons whatever stands in it.

cards.name: Harvest Moon
cards.description: When you are crowded, every tree drops its whole crop at once, wherever you are. +20% damage.

cards.name: Iron Bough
cards.description: The iron branches lash whatever stands under a tree, striking for 45% of a fruit and throwing it back. +20% damage.

cards.name: Cataclysm
cards.description: Whatever the flame kills leaves a burning crater, and anything that dies in a crater opens another. The crowd is the fuel.

cards.name: The Long Winter
cards.description: The cone opens into a full ring that freezes all it touches. The frozen shatter when they die, freezing their neighbours.

cards.name: The Lattice
cards.description: The chain stops ending. Everything it strikes stays linked for a few seconds, and the web keeps discharging along its own edges.

cards.name: Sundering
cards.description: Each cast shoves everything near you back and raises a broken ring of obsidian around you. Inside it you take less from every hit.

cards.name: Spring Tide
cards.description: Each wave floods the ground behind it, and the current drags whatever stands in it and will not let it walk.

cards.name: Wildwood
cards.description: A patch that finishes growing throws three seeds around itself, so every planting becomes a thicket.

cards.name: The Spirit Mirror
cards.description: Every tenth page, your black mirror opens over the thickest pack and draws every orb and flask in its reach to you.

cards.name: The Endless Chase
cards.description: The whirlwind catches enemy bolts and throws them back at the nearest enemy, three times as hard as a blade.

cards.name: The Five-Pointed Seal
cards.description: A ward that burns an enemy below a quarter of its health seals it there, harmless. When the ward goes out, all it sealed is gone.

cards.name: The Tempered Line
cards.description: Every blow the stakes take hardens the line, +5% a blow to +100%. Struck enough, it rings and cuts all along it.

cards.name: The Hundred Mouths
cards.description: Each burst sounds your other spells again on the beats that follow, at 40% strength.

cards.name: The Hungry Hedge
cards.description: Every enemy the vine kills feeds it: it sweeps further and wider for the rest of the run, to +60% reach and +40% arc.

cards.name: The Dose
cards.description: Each jump of the plague reaches half as many and doubles its dose: 8, 4, 2, then 1. The last carrier dies hardest.

cards.name: The Quatrains
cards.description: A star falls on any enemy that begins a wind-up or draws a bolt, before it can finish. What it stops must wait its cooldown again.

cards.name: Eye of Ra
cards.description: Each cast, the hottest ray flares like the sun. Whatever sees it loses you for two seconds and wanders. Hotter rays flare wider.

cards.name: Dragon's Teeth
cards.description: At full growth the flare throws a stone of light into the crowd: what it strikes turns on its neighbours for three seconds.

cards.name: All He Took
cards.description: Whatever your lanes kill gives up its light too. Catch it, and the lanes cross again.

cards.name: The Once and Future
cards.description: When the orb finishes its star it flies it again backwards. Your ward stands as long as you stay inside it.

cards.name: Not One Missed
cards.description: Every 4th volley is a count: a missile at every enemy in reach, up to 16, one each.

cards.name: Fata Morgana
cards.description: A mirage of you walks beside you facing the other way and casts behind you. Enemies near it chase it.

cards.name: Excalibur
cards.description: Every cut goes on through everything in a line behind its target, for 60% of the cut, and cuts every enemy bolt on the line.

cards.name: The Painted Door
cards.description: Closing a ring paints a door inside it, and whatever the ring holds steps out of a second door far across the field.

cards.name: The Hunter's Moon
cards.description: When your quarry falls, the mark passes to the strongest in reach and every lit star looses again.
